run_remesh_models_for_eval: run the script to uniformly resample and decimate 3D object models for BOP evaluation
run_meshlab_script_on_models: run meshlab server with a remesh script on all object models in a BOP dataset
get_model_params_for_dataset: get model parameters for input and output model types using dataset_params.get_model_params
ensure_output_dirs_for_models: ensure output directories exist before writing remeshed 3D model files
process_all_object_models: process models of all objects in a dataset by iterating over obj_ids and running meshlab
